audit.why: Swain early, skill-window mid, Swain late (drain-tank sustain outlasts spent engage cooldowns) matches packet levelChart Swain/Swain/Skill/Skill/Swain/Skill/Swain and content win[].

Spikes at lvl2 (root-Q before her crash-down engage), lvl6 (R drains through her stun chain), 1st item (skill window on kiting her cooldowns), late (drain tank out-sustains once W/R spent) are grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Rell's R (Magnet Storm) 'E magnet' in three places (spikes[2].text, late, wants.foe[1]) — enemyAbilities/enemyKit confirm Magnet Storm is her R, not E. missingInteractions also flagged two absent real interactions: her Q/W shields absorb burst, and her E auto-reset is the real combo tell (the packet defect further notes the page never names any of Rell's abilities).
audit.why: The R/E mislabel would send a reader to the wrong keybind for her pull ultimate; the shield and auto-reset tell change all-in timing.
audit.corrected: Swapped 'E magnet' -> 'R Magnet' in all three fields; folded the shield-absorb and auto-reset-tell interactions into the two bleed fixes (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d), and named real abilities with real numbers throughout.
